translated_title: Mexico Will Be the Fifth Market With Highest Corn Demand and Top Importer in 2035
original_title: México será el quinto mercado con más demanda de maíz y principal importador en 2035
author: Dora Villanueva
meta_description: OECD-FAO projections put Mexico at 10% of all corn traded worldwide by 2035, the widest gap between consumption and domestic production of any major buyer.
